test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four cities have been listed, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Bhopal, Gandhinagar and Chandigarh are capital of states Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Punjab/ Haryana respectively.

Whereas,

Kanpur is in Uttar Pradesh but not the capital of Uttar Pradesh.
